newsitem.title: USA: Standard Federal sees Q3 charge $1.37/shr.
newsitem.headline: Standard Federal sees Q3 charge $1.37/shr.

text.p: Standard Federal Bancorp Inc said Wednesday the assessment for federal deposit insurance fund recapitalization will result in a $43.8 million or $1.37 a share charge after tax to third quarter earnings.

A 72 percent reduction in prospective federal deposit insurance premium rates will lower the company's 1997 deposit insurance costs by about $11.8 million or $0.37 a share, after tax, and increase reported earnings by a similar amount.
The company took the charge as part of an industry-wide assessement that recapitalizes the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation's Savings Association Insurance Fund.
Standard Federal also said it will write off the remaining goodwill from three acquisitions as of the beginning of fiscal 1996 because of an accounting change.

The writeoff will result in a non-cash charge to earnings of $43 million or $1.34 a share in the first quarter of 1996, and a restatement of financial results for the first and second quarters of 1996.
The writeoff will reduce annual goodwill amortization of about $4 million or $0.12 a share after tax, beginning in 1996.
